caption: the week ahead, jan 18 to jan 24: aquarius season, then a full moon in leo on friday.

slides.headline: new *season*, full moon, and the one text you've been drafting
*mercury* gets serious, in a useful way
slides.body: astrologers read it as clear, grown-up talk. good day to set a boundary without a speech.

slides.headline: the sun enters *aquarius*
slides.body: capricorn hands over to aquarius. read it as a month for friends, ideas and doing things your own way.

slides.headline: the sun trines uranus, then sextiles *neptune*
slides.body: a surprise thursday, a softer friday. good days to try something you'd usually say no to.

slides.headline: full moon in *leo*: say it out loud
slides.body: the sun in aquarius, the moon opposite in leo. astrologers read it as heart versus head. the heart gets the mic.

slides.headline: mercury sextiles *venus*: the easy follow-up
slides.body: a sweet aspect for the text after the big night. say thanks, say more, say when.

slides.headline: say the brave thing friday. *follow up* saturday.
slides.body: save this for the full moon.
